name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Standalone Electron host for the DSH Web profile

scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm exec tsx ../../scripts/stage-desktop-runtime.ts && electron-builder --win nsis && pnpm exec tsx ../../scripts/verify-desktop-payload.ts ../../dist-desktop/win-unpacked/resources/runtime
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm build && pnpm exec tsx ../../scripts/stage-desktop-runtime.ts && electron-builder --win dir && pnpm exec tsx ../../scripts/verify-desktop-payload.ts ../../dist-desktop/win-unpacked/resources/runtime
